messages:
Maya: Heads-up — we got a DSAR asking for deletion of telemetry tied to a user ID that also shows up in our embeddings index. Request came in via privacy@ yesterday afternoon. Need to coordinate deletion + proof for legal. :thinking:
Ben: Ok. Do we know if the ID is in raw logs only or also in vector db and backups?
Maya: Found in live logs and embeddings (vector-db). Not sure about backups/snapshots — slacking infra about retention windows.
Sam-Eng: Quick note: our embeddings job stores vectors in vstore-prod (s3 + manifest). We run daily snapshots at 02:00 UTC and weekly archives. Deleting from the index is fast, but snapshots may hold it for up to 30 days unless we request expedited purge.
Olivia (Legal): We need confirmation of requester identity and scope. Also prepare a retention-exception request if we can't purge backups within the DSAR timeline. We need an audit trail showing steps taken.
Jess-Privacy: Can we pseudonymize old telemetry instead of full delete? If the requester insists on deletion under GDPR, we have to remove personal data. Suggest: scrub vectors, rotate keys for affected shard, and provide attestations.
Ben: Technical plan draft:
```
1) Identify all vector ids matching subject (query vector-db with metadata.user_id)
2) Run vector-db delete-by-id for matches: POST /v1/vectors/delete { "ids": [...] }
3) Invalidate KV cache + purge prefixes: redis-cli DEL prefix:userid:<id>*
4) Submit KMS access audit: request temporary decrypt rights to verify no encrypted blobs remain
```
Sam-Eng: For backups: open ticket to infra to run targeted snapshot wipe. We'll need retention-exception with RTO/RPO tradeoffs. I can attach a minimal manifest of removed vector ids for legal.
Maya: RBAC question: to run the KMS audit we need to grant Olivia and me limited keystore-read to the subject key for 24h. Is that OK?
Ben: Prefer to avoid key grants. Alternative: create an HSM-proxy job that verifies ciphertext presence without exposing plaintext — returns boolean and hashes we can attest to. That avoids temporary key exposure. I'll prototype today.
Olivia (Legal): HSM-proxy sounds better. Legal needs a signed statement from security that the proxy ran and what it verified (no plaintext returned).
Jess-Privacy: Also note data minimization follow-up: product should stop logging full user identifiers in telemetry. Proposed change: hash(user_id || salt) at collection point. I'll open a ticket.
Maya: Incident/vuln tie-in — while searching we found a failed ingestion job that retried with a bad payload containing extra metadata. Not high severity but flagging in case of data leakage.
Sam-Eng: I'll take a look, could be related to a backfill. Filing a vuln-triage card and linking to this thread.
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-2026: DSAR delete + backup purge request (assignee: Sam-Eng).
Ben: Next steps summary:
- Sam: open infra backup purge request + vuln triage card
- Ben: build HSM-proxy check and share attestation template
- Maya & Olivia: coordinate identity verification and retention-exception if needed
- Jess: start telemetry minimization ticket
Maya: Thanks. I'll update privacy@ with ETA and keep legal in the loop. :thumbsup:
